PLAY · SHADOW MATCHING

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains shadow matching on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Prefer paper? The Lion’s Shadow Safari worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
